title: 前美联储官员布拉德：罕见批评沃什发布会，称其未能打开9月政策空间
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Jim, for once I imagine you were happy you were on the inside and you were sitting on the outside.
segments.zh: 吉姆，我想你这次肯定庆幸自己是在场内而不是场外。

segments.en: What was your view of how that news conference went down yesterday? Well, unfortunately I thought it was a little bit rocky. It's probably not
segments.zh: 你怎么看昨天的新闻发布会？嗯，我觉得有点波折。

segments.en: unanticipated given that chairworsh is new in the role. This is a second press conference, but I thought, you know, the sell-off at the higher yields in the 30-year or, you know, kind of
segments.zh: 考虑到沃什主席刚上任，这并不意外。这是他第二次发布会，但30年期收益率走高引发的抛售，对央行官员来说很紧张。

segments.en: nerve wracking for a central banker, you know, dollar depreciation on the announcement. I think he needed to do more to create optionality in September, and he didn't do very much of that.
segments.zh: 美元在声明后贬值。我认为他需要为9月创造更多选择空间，但他没怎么做。

segments.en: Is he emphasized the inflation target and that he weren't backing off the inflation target, gave a little bit of hint that, you know, the measurements, you know, might be a factor there.
segments.zh: 他强调了通胀目标，不会放弃，并暗示测量指标可能是一个因素。

segments.en: I don't think that was helpful. And, you know, you might as well explain what the main arguments
segments.zh: 我认为这没有帮助。你最好解释一下会议上的主要论点。

segments.en: were around the table because the members are going to go out and tell you what they are thinking and basically what they're thinking. There are two more inflation reports to common. We want to see
segments.zh: 因为成员们会出去说出他们的想法，基本上就是：还有两份通胀报告要公布，我们想先看看。

segments.en: those inflation reports before we get going on any kind of hiking campaigns. So you might as well at least acknowledge, you know, the contours of the argument. I understand he doesn't want to give
segments.zh: 在开始任何加息行动之前，先看看这些报告。所以你至少应该承认争论的轮廓。

segments.en: forward guidance, but it's a work in progress and he's very accomplished, I think, in many ways,
segments.zh: 我理解他不想给出前瞻指引，但这需要改进。他在很多方面都很出色。
